newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Taiwan's Victor Taichung raises FRN to US$65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's Victor Taichung raises FRN to US$65 mln.

text.p: Victor Taichung Investment Co Ltd's floating rate note issue has been increased to US$65 million from US$40 million, arranger Citicorp said on Wednesday.
The deal is guaranteed by Victor Taichung Machinery Works Co Ltd.
The facility has a final maturity of five years with a put option in years three and four.
The issue was priced at par to float at 80 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
There is a put-option waiver fee of 10 basis points.
With fees, the all-in return for lead managers is 90 basis points.
Citicorp International is lead arranger. BNP Taipei, Credit Lyonnais and WestLB are co-arrangers and lead managers.
DKB Asia, Commerz East Asia, ING Bank and National Australia Bank Taipei are lead managers.
Cariplo S.p.A Singapore, Chinese Bank, Bank of Nova Scotia Taipei, DBS Taipei, Fubon Commercial Bank, Kredietbank Taipei, and Tokai Asia are managers.
Taishin International Bank, Bank Brussels Lambert Hong Kong, Far Eastern International Bank Offshore and HSBC Markets are co-managers.
